$comment: Intake's shared cases: the web (intake.test.ts) and Android (IntakeFixturesTest) both run every one. The files in fixtures/ are real DB Navigator shares and real tickets' `pdftotext -layout` text (DB, Trenitalia), anonymised (names, order and ticket numbers, ticket code replaced); the synthetic-*.pdf files are generated from those texts by fixtures/make-synthetic-pdf.mjs. Add a case here, not to either test.

return, 4 rides, no platforms and no headsigns

constructed from the return ticket: 3 travellers, one each with BC25, BC50 and none

pdf.name: the synthetic PDF of the ticket text extracts to text that parses the same
the synthetic PDF of the Trenitalia ticket text, two pages, extracts to text that parses the same

matching.name: outward: Transitous changes at Frankfurt Flughafen, so the rides are found one by one
return: the whole journey matches and is kept with its walks and refresh token
return: only the last ride is in the timetable; the others still get their stations, the one before it from its neighbour
outward: no station is known (outside the timetable or abroad), so the parsed rides are saved

ticket_summary.name: persons and their discounts, those without one left out
no count printed: one person per discount, sorted

ticket_cards.name: one card per BahnCard on the ticket, the largest first
a BahnCard 50 stands in for a 25
a card without a file, or not valid that day, is not shown
two BahnCards 25 on the ticket are two cards
no BahnCard on the ticket, none shown
a BahnCard 100 fare needs one per traveller

refinding.name: the timetable has it now: the same line at the same minutes, written without a space, after a walk
still missing: only another train, and the same train arriving at another minute
a ride found when saved is checked too: still there
a stop without an id cannot be searched from
dropped: not there, while a later train of its kind runs between its stops the same day
not dropped: only trains of another kind run later, so the timetable may not reach its train yet
not dropped: the next train of its kind is days later
a ride found when saved, with a new trip ref: found again, to be attached anew
a ride found when saved and gone since: dropped
a night train once a day, missing while it runs the next day: dropped
a train not running the next day but a week on, the same weekday: dropped
missing, and neither the next day nor a week on: the timetable may not reach it yet
RE19 on the ticket is RE19 (4901) in the timetable: the same train, found, not dropped
RE19 (4903) is another RE19 than RE19 (4901): not the booked train

replacing.name: ICE 725 from the airport instead of the Hbf: ICE 17 is left there, ICE 700 stays as booked
the same trains, but the booked change after them no longer works: the traveller chooses
only another train: the traveller chooses
the first ride dropped and running a little earlier: taken from that ride
a booked ride after it is not in the timetable either: the traveller chooses
